info.title: KeetaNet node HTTP API
info.description: The HTTP API of a KeetaNet node as described by version 0.18.7 of @keetanetwork/keetanet-client. The routes are those of the "rootTree" in the package's API typings (api/index.d.ts); the request and response shapes are the typed values as the package serializes them. Citations name the package's bundle, client/index.js, by line ([Keeta TS] index.js:N), or its typings by file. A response body is the handler's result passed through the package's JSON conversion with binary encodings added, which is why blocks, votes, quotes and staples at the top of a response carry "$binary" (the client decodes them from it, [Keeta TS] index.js:58891, 58977, 59808, 59814, 59923). Every route is served below /api [Keeta TS] index.js:61390.

post.summary: Ask the node to vote for blocks
post.description: The blocks are ASN.1 encoded and base64 encoded; "votes" carries the votes of other representatives when a permanent vote is requested, and "quote" a fee quote previously issued by this node [Keeta TS] index.js:59855-59866, 59775. The client reads the vote from "vote.$binary" [Keeta TS] index.js:59806-59810.

votes.description: When the client sends it, it always sends at least one: it refuses to ask with an empty list [Keeta TS] index.js:59861-59863.

500.description: A failure of the whole request. Status 500 is inferred from the GET routes, where representatives answer every such failure with it; no POST was sent to a representative to observe it.

AccountPath.name: account

EntityList.description: Entity accounts separated by commas [Keeta TS] index.js:58588-58597, 59958-59960.

Side.name: side
Side.description: Which ledger to read: "main" holds what has been voted for permanently, "side" what is still awaiting votes [Keeta TS] index.js:67868-67873, 58778-58789. The API error codes include INVALID_SIDE [Keeta TS] index.js:66022-66030.

BlockSide.name: side
BlockSide.description: Which ledger to find the block on: "main", "side", or "both", which the client asks for when it recovers an account [Keeta TS] index.js:59349-59351, and which the ledger reads from either [Keeta TS] index.js:69502-69505, 67668. The API error codes include INVALID_SIDE [Keeta TS] index.js:66022-66030.

HistoryStart.name: start
HistoryStart.description: The staple the page continues after, as the hash of its blocks: the "nextKey" of the previous page [Keeta TS] index.js:58951-58954, 58986-58990.

HistoryLimit.name: limit
HistoryLimit.description: The largest number of staples to return, in decimal [Keeta TS] index.js:58948-58951. The API error codes include LIMIT_NOT_NUMBER, LIMIT_NOT_GREATER_THAN_ZERO and INVALID_LIMIT [Keeta TS] index.js:66022-66030.

Error.description: A failure of the whole request: any non-2xx status; representatives use 500, for a request they refuse as well as for one they fail to serve. The client reads the body of a response that is not ok and, when its "error" is true, rebuilds the KeetaNet error from it [Keeta TS] index.js:59629-59652; any other body of such a response is reported as text, and with a status of 500 or more the client stops retrying [Keeta TS] index.js:59658-59671. The body of a 200 is returned as data, whatever it holds [Keeta TS] index.js:59673-59685, so a failure scoped to one part of a request, such as a malformed account in an account-state request, is answered with a 200 and described by that route's 200 schema.

BigInt.description: An integer as "0x" followed by its magnitude in uppercase hexadecimal without leading zeros, after a "-" when negative [Keeta TS] index.js:78420-78433.

DecimalCount.description: A positive integer in decimal, as a query parameter.

Account.description: An account as its public key string: "keeta_" and the base32 of the key type, the 32- or 33-byte public key and a 5-byte checksum, in lowercase without padding [Keeta TS] index.js:62455-62468, 76739-76744, 63012-63014.

AccountList.description: Accounts separated by commas [Keeta TS] index.js:59958-59960.

Hash.description: A 32-byte hash in uppercase hexadecimal [Keeta TS] index.js:63186-63193, 76858-76862.

HashInput.description: A 32-byte hash in hexadecimal, as a request parameter; the hash types decode hexadecimal of either case [Keeta TS] index.js:76805-76814.

HexBytes.description: Bytes in uppercase hexadecimal [Keeta TS] index.js:78439-78443.

Base64.description: Bytes in standard base64 with padding [Keeta TS] index.js:63911-63913.

Date.description: A moment as an ISO 8601 date in UTC with milliseconds [Keeta TS] index.js:78436-78437.

Permissions.description: The base and external permission sets as two integers [Keeta TS] index.js:74240-74242.

BlockSigner.description: The signer of a block: an account, or a multisig account and its signers, each of which may itself be a multisig pair (lib/block/index.d.ts, BlockSignerField).

CertificateHashPrincipal.description: A principal that holds a certificate issued under the named certificate [Keeta TS] index.js:65597-65610.

PEMCertificate.description: A certificate as PEM text: the base64 of its DER encoding in lines of at most 64 characters, between the PEM boundaries, each line ending in a line feed [Keeta TS] index.js:78109-78120.

DistinguishedName.description: A distinguished name as its parts in order, each the attribute's name and value [Keeta TS] index.js:77061-77072.

Certificate.description: A certificate in an operation, as it serializes itself: the fields parsed from it, its hash and, in "$binary", its PEM text, which an operation always includes [Keeta TS] index.js:78141-78167, 65760-65767. "subject" and "issuer" are the distinguished names as text, "subjectDN" and "issuerDN" the same names as parts, and "subjectPublicKey" the subject's account [Keeta TS] index.js:77644-77651.

CertificateBaseExtensions.description: The X.509 extensions the package parses, each present when the certificate carries it [Keeta TS] index.js:78236-78275: basic constraints as whether the subject is a certificate authority and its path length, null when absent; key usage as one flag per usage; and the key identifiers.

keyUsage.description: Every usage the package names, each set or not [Keeta TS] index.js:77515-77525, 78210-78235.

authorityKeyIdentifier.description: The key identifier as the ASN.1 context value it is tagged with, implicitly or, in older certificates, explicitly [Keeta TS] index.js:78260-78268.

Operation.description: A block operation, told apart by "type" [Keeta TS] index.js:64636-64646. Each serializes its own fields, leaving out the optional ones it does not have.

OperationModifyPermissions.description: MODIFY_PERMISSIONS; "permissions" is null when the row is removed [Keeta TS] index.js:65583-65591.

OperationCreateIdentifier.description: CREATE_IDENTIFIER; "createArguments" configures a multisig identifier [Keeta TS] index.js:65337-65343.

type.description: The multisig key type [Keeta TS] index.js:61554.

OperationTokenAdminSupply.description: TOKEN_ADMIN_SUPPLY; the method only adds or subtracts [Keeta TS] index.js:65655-65661.

OperationReceive.description: RECEIVE; "exact" is false unless set [Keeta TS] index.js:65148-65157, 65159-65163.

OperationManageCertificate.description: MANAGE_CERTIFICATE: a certificate when adding, its hash when removing; the method only adds or subtracts [Keeta TS] index.js:65760-65767. Intermediates serialize as a bundle of PEM texts [Keeta TS] index.js:77504-77510.

BlockContent.description: A block's fields as the block serializes them [Keeta TS] index.js:63910-63939. "idempotent" is base64 and "subnet" an integer, each left out when the block has none; a version 1 block carries one "signature", a version 2 block a list of "signatures", in uppercase hexadecimal [Keeta TS] index.js:63915-63924.

purpose.description: 0 is a generic block, 1 a fee block [Keeta TS] index.js:63126-63129.

Block.description: A block with its ASN.1 encoding in "$binary", as a response carries it [Keeta TS] index.js:63911-63913.

StapledBlock.description: A block inside a staple, serialized without "$binary" [Keeta TS] index.js:81097-81099.

VoteFee.description: A fee a vote asks for: the amount and, when given, the token and the account to pay (lib/vote.d.ts, FeeAmountAndToken).

VoteContent.description: A vote's or a quote's fields as it serializes them [Keeta TS] index.js:80606-80630. "$uid" is "ID=", the issuer, "/Serial=" and the serial in decimal; "$id" is the hash of "$uid" in uppercase hexadecimal [Keeta TS] index.js:80569-80570. The signature is uppercase hexadecimal [Keeta TS] index.js:78439-78440. "fee" is a single fee or a non-empty list of choices, and "quote" whether the fee is quoted rather than asked for; both come from the same extension, so they are present together or not at all [Keeta TS] index.js:79963-80020, 80492-80502, 80611-80616.

Vote.description: A vote with its encoding in "$binary", as a response carries it [Keeta TS] index.js:80607-80609. A vote is no quote: "quote" is false when it asks for a fee and absent otherwise [Keeta TS] index.js:80213-80215, 80497-80499, 80652, 80660-80662.

VoteQuote.description: A fee quote with its encoding in "$binary"; a quote serializes as a vote does [Keeta TS] index.js:80606-80630, and always carries its fee with "quote" true [Keeta TS] index.js:80213-80218, 80696-80698, 80702.

StapledVote.description: A vote inside a staple, serialized without "$binary" [Keeta TS] index.js:81094-81096; like any vote, it is no quote.

VoteStaple.description: Votes and the blocks they vote for, with the staple's encoding in "$binary" [Keeta TS] index.js:81088-81101.

HistoryPage.description: A page of staples, newest first; "nextKey" is the "$id" of the page's last staple, the "start" of the next page. A page without staples, which the client takes as the end of the history [Keeta TS] index.js:58969-58971, gives the "start" it was asked for, or null when it was asked for none [Keeta TS] index.js:58986-58996.

$id.description: The hash of the staple's blocks, which the client takes as the next page's start where "nextKey" is missing [Keeta TS] index.js:58991-58994, 81044-81053.

$timestamp.description: A moment the node records with the staple; it differs from the staple's own timestamp, the average of its votes' validity [Keeta TS] index.js:81061-81087.

AccountInfo.description: An account's info. Identifier accounts may carry "defaultPermission", a token its "supply", a multisig account its "multisigQuorum" (lib/ledger/types.d.ts, AccountInfo; [Keeta TS] index.js:59971-59999).

Balances.description: An account's balance of each token, in the token's raw units (lib/ledger/types.d.ts, GetAllBalancesResponse; [Keeta TS] index.js:59961-59967).

AccountState.description: An account's head, representative, info and balances (api/node.d.ts, AccountState; [Keeta TS] index.js:60000-60023).

AccountStateError.description: Why an account's state could not be read: exactly the account and a message [Keeta TS] index.js:58241-58256.

ACLRow.description: A permission row: the principal holds "permissions" on "entity", optionally scoped to "target". The principal is an account, or a certificate under which issued certificates qualify [Keeta TS] index.js:60024-60053.

PrincipalAccess.description: A principal and, per entity it holds permissions on, the entity's info, balances and the rows (api/node.d.ts, PrincipalACLWithInfoResponse).

RepresentativeWeight.description: A representative and its voting weight (api/node.d.ts, GetRepresentativeAPIResponse; [Keeta TS] index.js:60066-60070).

Endpoints.description: Where a node serves its API and its peer-to-peer socket (config/index.d.ts, Endpoints): the client fetches the API below "api" [Keeta TS] index.js:59584, 72201, and opens a WebSocket to "p2p" [Keeta TS] index.js:72250.

Peer.description: A peer record: a representative with its key, endpoints, preferred update channel and either a base64 signature over the record or a certificate, or a participant with only its kind [Keeta TS] index.js:71988-72019. Kinds are 0 participant, 1 representative, 2 relay, 3 archival [Keeta TS] index.js:71287-71292; a peer record is written only for a representative or a participant.

TimeStat.description: How many events took a duration within "range", in milliseconds; a count of -1 marks a placeholder [Keeta TS] index.js:74388-74396.

TimeStats.description: One count per duration bucket [Keeta TS] index.js:74283-74303.

P2PSwitchStatistics.description: Message counts of the peer-to-peer switch (lib/p2p.d.ts, P2PSwitchStatistics).

Error.description: The body of a failure of the whole request: a refusal, which names the KeetaNet error, or an internal failure, which names only an error ID.

ErrorRefusal.description: A request the node refuses, as the KeetaNet error it raised: its type, code and message [Keeta TS] index.js:66067-66073. A ledger vote error adds the accounts party to the conflict [Keeta TS] index.js:66533-66540, and an idempotent-key error adds the account, the key and both block hashes [Keeta TS] index.js:66575-66590. The client rebuilds the error from these fields, reading "shouldRetry" and "retryDelay" of a ledger error when present [Keeta TS] index.js:66334-66410.

type.description: The error's family; GENERIC when none applies [Keeta TS] index.js:66054, 65980, 66021, 66090, 66161, 66187, 66225, 66426, 66452, 66607, 66636.

code.description: The type, an underscore and the code within the type, such as LEDGER_NOT_SUCCESSOR [Keeta TS] index.js:66055-66062.

ErrorInternal.description: A failure the node did not anticipate: exactly "error" and a message naming the error ID under which the node recorded it.
